name: Frans Francken the Younger

summary.text: Frans Francken the Younger was a Flemish painter and the best-known and most prolific member of the large Francken family of artists. He painted large altarpieces for churches as well as smaller historical, mythological and allegorical scenes.
summary.title: Frans Francken the Younger
